parameters.content:
## Shopify scheduled sync
Select your existing Header Auth credential in the HTTP node:
Header: X-Operator-Key
Value: N8N_OPERATOR_KEY from the backend configuration.

Run the manual trigger first, then publish for the 15-minute schedule.
Keep Docker n8n and the dashboard server on port 3000 running.

Retries: 3 attempts, 5-second fixed wait. Timeout: 120 seconds.
Failures are recorded as failed executions. No email alerts are sent.
Backend overlap protection must remain enabled.
